$comment: Tool manifest for the agentbadge CLI. agentbadge is a command-line tool, not an MCP server, so this file declares its callable tools rather than an mcpServers entry. Each tool maps to a CLI invocation and its JSON output contract is in openapi.json.
name: agentbadge

tools.name: agentbadge_scan
tools.title: Scan repository agent readiness
tools.description: Scores a repository's AI-agent readiness from 0 to 100 across five pillars and returns the result as JSON. Equivalent to running `agentbadge scan <path> --json`.

path.description: Path to the repository root to scan.
